27.content:
# claude.md - Adyen Underperformance Playbook (consolidated single tree)

## Purpose
Agent-facing diagnostic playbook for merchant payment underperformance. The agent picks a scenario, answers a short chain of questions, and receives a single Recommended Actions screen, then a summary email closes out the session. Runs in the Adyen agent tool (styles.css + adyenLoader.js loaded via script_code). `${agent}` is expected on the session URL.

## Architecture (one tree, ~25 nodes)
Replaces the previous 7-tree hub-and-spoke export (Starting Workflow + 6 subtrees, ~70 nodes, ~50 dead ends). Every path now converges on: Build recommended actions (catalog Script) -> Recommended actions (Content, renders `${transforms.outcome_html}`) -> Email the session summary -> Summary sent (single terminal). No dead ends.

Flow:
- Root Script "Extract agent first name" (seeds agent_first_name from the agent query param) -> Content "Select the underperformance scenario" (first rendered screen; back/restart hidden) -> 5 buttons to the branch entry screens.
- Each branch = one Content question screen (native conditional form fields) -> one eval Script (sets `outcome_key`, and a routing boolean when the path can continue to another screen) -> optional Scoring router (tests only script-set booleans, or the verbatim competitor checkbox expression).
- Terminal outcomes: eval Script (or, for Protect ML, conditional hidden `outcome_key` fields) set `outcome_key` and continue straight to the catalog.
- The catalog Script owns an `OUTCOMES` lookup map (outcome_key -> HTML) built from the original nodes' content verbatim; it stages `outcome_html` for the shared Recommended actions screen.

Branches: MOB alert (mob -> mob_eval -> mob_router), Sanity checks (sanity -> sanity_eval -> sanity_router), Deeper diagnostics (deep -> deep_eval -> deep_router), Competitor comparison (competitor -> competitor_router), Payment Conversion Rate (pcr -> pcr_eval -> pcr_router -> protectml), Fraud rate (fraud -> fraud_eval), Decline reasons (decline -> decline_eval; shared - reached from deep_router, competitor_router).

## Data dictionary
Inbound query param: `agent` (email in the form firstname.lastname@domain; used for greeting + email recipient).
Derived variable: `agent_first_name` = text before the first period of `agent`. Created by the root Script node "Extract agent first name" via `ZT.setFormData` (runs before anything renders, so it displays on the picker and is captured in the session/transcript/email). The root is a Script node on purpose - seeding data from query params is a standard entry pattern.
Form variables (native selects unless noted):
- mob_recovered, mob_has_advice, mob_advice; mob_go_sanity (bool, script)
- seasonality_effect, new_or_different_traffic, merchant_is_initiating_more_retries; sanity_go_deep (bool)
- issuer_bin, oneoff_platform, experiments; deep_go_decline (bool)
- sameTrafficAndSetup, same_success_metrics, comparison_valid (checkboxes, checkbox_score=1) - competitor_router tests `comparison_valid == 1` (op-based Scoring, verbatim from source)
- pcr_significant, pcr; pcr_go_protect (bool)
- protect_ml_adopted
- protect_premium, fraud_ml, fraud_main_provider, fraud_recs, fraud_diff; fraud_all_confirmed ("yes"/"no")
- decline_reason, au_nto, no_specific_product
- outcome_key (string, drives the catalog); overwrite-safe plain hidden `outcome_key="comparison_not_fair"` on the competitor screen is re-set downstream when the fair path continues to decline.
Transforms:
- outcome_html (produced by catalog Script or directly by sanity_eval when outcome_key="prebuilt"; consumed by the Recommended actions Content node).

## External systems
None. No CX Actions / Connected Objects - confirmed static (Brent, Jul 2026). All screens are static guidance + links to Adyen dashboards/Confluence/Slack, preserved verbatim from the source trees.

## Conventions & gotchas
- `merge_vars_not_fixed="1"` is REQUIRED: the shared Recommended actions node renders `${transforms.outcome_html}` staged per path; without it the first-rendered value would stick.
- Routers use `advanced_logic_node="1"` + empty fallback and test script booleans (`flag == true`) - except competitor_router which is the org-proven op-based checkbox Scoring (`comparison_valid == 1`, advanced_logic_node="0").
- Native `select` (Yes/No) used instead of the source's checkboxes/radios wherever a script reads the answer (reliably readable, enforces `required`). The four Fraud verification checkboxes became Yes/No selects; fraud_all_confirmed drives whether the outcome prepends the "not all confirmed" alert.
- Conditional fields (`config.conditional.simple`) collapse each branch's dependent questions onto one screen.
- Protect ML uses two conditional hidden `outcome_key` fields (mutually exclusive) - dev-test the duplicate-name behavior once in Zingtree.

## Back/Restart
First rendered content node "Select the underperformance scenario" carries `hide_back_restart="1"` (best-effort; the per-node field is unproven in this org - dev-test it). Tree-wide `hide_back_button`/`show_restart_button` left at defaults so Back/Restart stay available on the diagnostic screens.

## Changelog
- 2026-07-22 - Agent-name entry, minimal (prompt: "root can be a Script node; just add one script node that pulls agent_first_name; hide back/restart on first node") - Made the root a Script node "Extract agent first name" (ZT.setFormData from `agent` split on ".") that flows into the picker; hid back/restart on the picker (first rendered screen). One node added vs. the consolidated tree. New var agent_first_name. Nodes now 27. (Superseded the prior verify-screen + script_code approach.)
- 2026-07-22 - Consolidation (prompt: "streamline 7 trees into one, dynamic-HTML outcomes, no dead ends, everything returns to the email node") - Collapsed 7 trees/70 nodes into one tree/~25 nodes. Built OUTCOMES catalog script + single dynamic-HTML Recommended actions screen; converted checkbox/radio inputs to native conditional selects; removed all ~50 dead ends; every path now funnels to Email -> Summary sent. Created this claude.md node.
